title: context_pack
description: A typed, versioned, immutable prefix asset for a cache-native agent task.

task.description: One-line description of the unit of work this pack exists for.

prefix_hash.description: Content hash of the assembled immutable prefix. Filled in by context_prime.py; absent on a freshly drafted (not yet primed) pack.

parent_pack.description: The context_pack this one checkpoints forward from, or null if this is v1.

base.description: The immutable prefix's content, in the fixed order it will be assembled.

system_prompt.description: Path to the system prompt file used for this pack.

tool_contract.description: Path to the frozen tool/schema definition used for this pack. Changing this invalidates the prefix.

architecture_summary.description: Path to a generated project architecture summary (from context_index.py).

dependency_graph.description: Path to the relevant slice of .context-fabric/graph.json for this task's code cone.

invariants.description: Explicit statements the implementation must not violate. Written/validated by the quality-lane model.

acceptance_tests.description: Concrete, checkable tests (paths or descriptions) that define done.

unknowns.description: Ambiguities the fast lane flagged for the quality lane to resolve before finalizing.

compaction_threshold_pct.description: Trigger a checkpoint when the append-only tail reaches this % of prefill_tokens.

checkpoint.description: Present only on packs produced by /context-checkpoint from a prior pack.
